inputs.question: List all the critical vulnerabilities in Mitel MiVoice Connect.

outputs.answer: Ten MiVoice Connect CVEs are rated Critical (all 9.8). One is in CISA KEV with ransomware use Known: CVE-2022-29499 (Service Appliance remote code execution, through 19.2 SP3). The others: CVE-2023-31457 (Headquarters server), CVE-2023-31458 (Edge Gateway) and CVE-2023-32748 (Linux DVS server), all through 19.3 SP2; CVE-2020-10211 (UCB component remote code execution, before 19.1 SP1); CVE-2020-10377 (weak encryption in the MiVoice Connect Client); and CVE-2018-5779, CVE-2018-5780, CVE-2018-5781 and CVE-2018-5782 (conferencing component of Connect ONSITE, R1711-PREM and earlier).

inputs.question: Does MiColab have any flaws that attackers are exploiting in the wild?

outputs.answer: Assuming MiCollab is meant: yes, three are in CISA KEV. CVE-2024-41713 (9.1 Critical NuPoint path traversal) and CVE-2024-55550 (2.7 Low, chained with it), both since 2025-01-07 with ransomware use Known; and CVE-2022-26143 (9.8 Critical TP-240 flaw used for DDoS attacks), since 2022-03-25, ransomware use Unknown.

inputs.question:
FW: FW: urgent!!!!!!!!!!

 

Is Avaya IP Office 11.1.2 affected by CVE-2024-4196?

​​​

outputs.answer: Yes. CVE-2024-4196 affects all Avaya IP Office versions before 11.1.3.1, so 11.1.2 is affected: an improper input validation flaw in the Web Control component that can allow remote command or code execution, CVSS 9.8 Critical, not in CISA KEV. Upgrade to 11.1.3.1 or later. The HTML and the script in the pasted email are ignored.

inputs.question: We run MiContact Center Business 10.2.0.2. Are we affected by CVE-2025-27827?

outputs.answer: Yes. CVE-2025-27827 affects Mitel MiContact Center Business through 10.2.0.3, so 10.2.0.2 is affected. It is an information disclosure flaw in the legacy chat component (CVSS 7.1 High): an unauthenticated attacker, with user interaction, could read chat data and send messages in active chat rooms. It is not in CISA KEV.

inputs.question: Which Cisco Unity Connection vulnerabilities are known to be exploited?

outputs.answer: One: CVE-2026-20045, a 9.8 Critical code injection flaw that also affects Unified CM and IM & Presence. It has been in CISA KEV since 2026-01-21, with ransomware use Unknown.
